name: loop-breaker
description: Notices when the main session or a subagent goes in circles (the same failing command, the same error, undoing and redoing an edit, a test flipping) and breaks the loop: a note, then a second opinion from the same model, then a stop with a decision for the owner.

repeats.title: Repeats before it steps in
repeats.description: How many times the same failing command or the same error may repeat before loop-breaker steps in.

secondOpinion.title: Ask for a second opinion
secondOpinion.description: On the second trigger, ask the same model the stuck agent runs on for a fresh look (one extra model call). Off: the second trigger stops the agent.
